tasks.instruction: MUSE-56: independent full-circle transport evidence for EXISTING createMetricSpace in engine/geometry/metric-space.js. Read AGENTS.md and MUSE.md; this manifest is the complete assignment if the queue in your clone predates it. Allowed writes global-s3-transport-truth.test.js and docs/qa/muse56-global-transport.md only. No kernel, app, schema, other test or queue edits. Run host-probe once, do not investigate environment. Build deterministic tests of stepWithTransport on S3 at R=0.5,8,10000: full 2*pi*R loop returning point/direction/three carried tangent vectors, half-circle landing at antipode using segment carry (not endpoint transport), many short steps vs one full loop, and a closed triangular loop with NONZERO holonomy checked independently against spherical triangle area on a great S2. Use the three mutually orthogonal unit points e4,e1,e2, whose area is pi/2 on the unit sphere; transport along explicit pi/2 segments, compare signed rotation of an initial in-plane tangent to that area, include reversed loop. Maximum 12 checks, bounded runtime; check norms and tangency. Distinguish existing bounded withinDomain from globally defined step formula; do not relax patch guards. Demonstrate an isolated fail mutation such as identity carry, restore engine and verify git diff engine empty. Run focused test; report errors, command, host, revision and limitations in under 500 words. No browser, full suite, agent launches, commits or pushes. Return READY FOR REVIEW.
